panels.title: Instance Summary

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (increase(pavonis_server_http_request_total{job="$job",code=~"5.."}[$__range])) or on (instance) ((0 * sum by (instance) (increase(pavonis_server_http_request_total{job="$job"}[$__range]))) unless on (instance) sum by (instance) (count_over_time(pavonis_server_http_request_total{job="$job",code=~"5.."}[$__range])))

sum by (instance) (increase(pavonis_upstream_http_request_total{job="$job",code=~"5.."}[$__range])) or on (instance) ((0 * sum by (instance) (increase(pavonis_upstream_http_request_total{job="$job"}[$__range]))) unless on (instance) sum by (instance) (count_over_time(pavonis_upstream_http_request_total{job="$job",code=~"5.."}[$__range])))

sum by (instance) (increase(pavonis_upstream_http_request_total{job="$job",code=""}[$__range])) or on (instance) ((0 * sum by (instance) (increase(pavonis_upstream_http_request_total{job="$job"}[$__range]))) unless on (instance) sum by (instance) (count_over_time(pavonis_upstream_http_request_total{job="$job",code=""}[$__range])))

sum by (instance) (increase(pavonis_server_rate_limit_rejections_total{job="$job"}[$__range])) or on (instance) ((0 * sum by (instance) (increase(pavonis_server_http_request_total{job="$job"}[$__range]))) unless on (instance) sum by (instance) (count_over_time(pavonis_server_rate_limit_rejections_total{job="$job"}[$__range])))

panels.description: All instances and sites in the selected job, independent of Side, Instance and Site selections. Request counts, response body bytes and error counts are estimated totals over the selected time range. Upstream counts include redirects and authentication probes. Status is the current Prometheus scrape status. Missing metrics or insufficient samples are shown as a dash.

panels.title: ${side:text} · Request Count
panels.description: Estimated completed requests since the previous plotted point.

panels.title: ${side:text} · 5xx Responses
panels.description: Count and share of HTTP 5xx responses in the selected time range. Upstream requests without a response are shown as N/A in the status-code panels and counted in Upstream Details.

panels.title: ${side:text} · Body Bytes
panels.description: Request and response body bytes over the selected time range. Client measures request bytes read and response bytes written. Upstream measures body bytes read by Pavonis and its transport.

panels.title: ${side:text} · Request Rate
panels.description: Completed HTTP requests per second.

panels.title: ${side:text} · Total Requests
panels.description: Completed requests across the selected sites in the selected time range.

panels.title: Request Count by Site
panels.description: Estimated requests per interval. Legend Total sums the displayed intervals.

panels.title: Request Count by Status Code

targets.expr: label_replace((sum by (code) (increase(pavonis_${side}_http_request_total{job="$job",instance="$instance",site=~"${site:regex}"}[$__interval])) or on (code) (0 * sum by (code) (count_over_time(pavonis_${side}_http_request_total{job="$job",instance="$instance",site=~"${site:regex}"}[$__range] @ end())))) and on () (min(up{job="$job",instance="$instance"}) == 1), "code", "N/A", "code", "^$")

panels.description: Estimated requests per interval. Legend Total sums the displayed intervals. N/A means the upstream request ended without an HTTP response header.

panels.title: Request Rate by Status Code

targets.expr: label_replace((sum by (code) (rate(pavonis_${side}_http_request_total{job="$job",instance="$instance",site=~"${site:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])) or on (code) (0 * sum by (code) (count_over_time(pavonis_${side}_http_request_total{job="$job",instance="$instance",site=~"${site:regex}"}[$__range] @ end())))) and on () (min(up{job="$job",instance="$instance"}) == 1), "code", "N/A", "code", "^$")

panels.description: N/A means the upstream request ended without an HTTP response header.

panels.title: Request Share by Site
panels.description: Request counts and shares across the selected sites and time range.

panels.title: Request Share by Status Code
panels.description: Completed requests by HTTP status code for the selected sites and time range. N/A means the upstream request ended without an HTTP response header.

panels.title: Request Share by HTTP Method
panels.description: Completed requests by HTTP method for the selected sites and time range.

panels.title: Total Requests
panels.description: Completed requests across the selected sites in the selected time range.

panels.title: Request Duration
panels.description: Rolling 5-minute duration, including response body transfer.

panels.title: Response Body Size
panels.description: Rolling 5-minute window. Gaps indicate insufficient observations.

panels.title: Mean Request Duration by Site
panels.description: Rolling 5-minute averages. Legend Mean averages the plotted values over the selected time range.

panels.title: Mean Response Body Size by Site
panels.description: Rolling 5-minute averages. Legend Mean averages the plotted values over the selected time range.

panels.title: Request Body Size
panels.description: Body bytes actually read, over a rolling 5-minute window.

panels.title: Mean Request Body Size by Site
panels.description: Rolling 5-minute averages. Legend Mean averages the plotted values over the selected time range.

panels.title: Request Duration Distribution
panels.description: Estimated completed requests per time interval and bucket.

panels.title: Response Body Size Distribution
panels.description: Estimated completed requests per time interval and bucket.

panels.title: Requests In Flight by HTTP Method
panels.description: In-flight requests by HTTP method across the selected sites and Side. Includes request and response body transfer. Legend Max is the maximum of the plotted samples.

panels.title: Upstream Request Rate by Hop
panels.description: Upstream requests across the selected sites, independent of Side. Hop 0 is the initial request, and each followed redirect increments the hop. Counts all outcomes, including requests without a response.

panels.title: Upstream No Response Rate by Hop

targets.expr: sum by (hop) (rate(pavonis_upstream_http_request_total{job="$job",instance="$instance",site=~"${site:regex}",code=""}[$__rate_interval])) or on (hop) (0 * sum by (hop) (rate(pavonis_upstream_http_request_total{job="$job",instance="$instance",site=~"${site:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.description: Upstream requests across the selected sites, independent of Side. Hop 0 is the initial request, and each followed redirect increments the hop. Counts requests that ended without an HTTP response header, including connection errors and timeouts. Zero is shown for hops with observed traffic and no such errors.

panels.title: Local Rate Limit Rejections by Site
panels.description: Requests rejected by the local request rate limiter across the selected sites, independent of Side.

panels.title: Total Local Rate Limit Rejections by Site
panels.description: Requests rejected by the local request rate limiter across the selected sites, independent of Side.

panels.title: CPU Usage
panels.description: Whole-instance metric, independent of Site selection.

panels.title: Memory Usage
panels.description: Whole-instance metric, independent of Site selection.

panels.title: GC Pause Time
panels.description: Milliseconds per second spent in stop-the-world GC pauses, averaged over 5 minutes. Whole-instance metric, independent of Site selection.

panels.title: Goroutines
panels.description: Whole-instance metric, independent of Site selection.

list.name: site
list.label: Site
list.description: Filters request metrics. Total combines the selected sites.

list.name: side
list.label: Side
list.description: Client counts requests received by Pavonis. Upstream counts each upstream round trip, including redirects and authentication probes.
